name: Acres of Adventure at The Pickwick Place
description: Acres of Adventure at The Pickwick Place is an agritourism farm in 1875 N Sandusky Ave, OH, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
